structure: ruling-design-2026-11-13.md: a short Markdown ruling file, 31 lines, holding design's answers to the three design calls on the "Three Design Calls" page (https://claude.ai/artifact/Ai4JjvLxchDPrPqp39Tj7C), passed on by Sam. Laid out in four pieces, in order: a two-line heading and provenance note (lines 1-4, naming design as the author, Sam as the route and the Three Design Calls page as the question set); a verbatim block quote of design's own words (lines 6-12, four lines: "Ok so I'm going to propose the following", "Include the Add country button", "Implement address searching without live filtering", "People can get a feel for it and if necessary we can return to the area and think of a way to do it", "Don't build the copy buttons"); a "## Decided" section (lines 14-26) with exactly three numbered decisions, each a bolded headline sentence plus the behaviour it keeps, what is not built, and the increment and requirement ids it drops (1. transit countries keep the 'Add country' button, inc-030 dropped with req-348, req-349, req-353, req-354; 2. address search does not filter as the trader types, inc-193 dropped with req-592, req-1951, req-2039; 3. no Copy buttons on the import reference numbers, inc-198 dropped with req-1986); and a closing "Not covered here" paragraph (lines 28-31) naming two areas this ruling does not settle and the earlier rulings that still hold them (inc-194 deferred as concept work under ruling:sam-2026-11-09 point 2, inc-014 commodity search as you type still waiting on its own ticket under ruling:sam-2026-11-10 point 2). The scope is "whole file", so nothing is left out, and the file is far smaller than one part, so it is one part: the whole file read word for word, with the block quote as the source and the three numbered items as the main session's reading to be checked against it.

parts.title: The whole 13 November design ruling
parts.scope: The whole of ruling-design-2026-11-13.md, lines 1 to 31: the heading and provenance note, the verbatim block quote, all three numbered items under '## Decided', and the closing 'Not covered here' paragraph. Nothing in the file belongs to another part.
read: # Ruling: design, 13 November 2026 — heading and provenance note (lines 1-4)
The verbatim block quote of design's words (lines 6-12)
covers: The provenance: design is the author, these are its answers to the three calls on the 'Three Design Calls' page (https://claude.ai/artifact/Ai4JjvLxchDPrPqp39Tj7C), and Sam passed them on — so the ruling's authority and what question set it answers

Every line of the block quote as the source text the three numbered items must be checked against: 'Include the Add country button', 'Implement address searching without live filtering', 'People can get a feel for it and if necessary we can return to the area and think of a way to do it', 'Don't build the copy buttons'

Decision 1, transit countries: a country is added only when the trader presses 'Add country' and not as soon as it is picked; Remove reloads the page; this is what main already does; adding on pick, removing in place and the 'Added' and 'Removed' announcements are not built; inc-030 dropped with req-348, req-349, req-353 and req-354 out of scope

Decision 2, address search: it does not filter as the trader types; the trader types then presses Search or Enter; on every party picker, the place of origin picker and the address book list; this is the server search main already has; the rows that filter as the trader types are not built; inc-193 dropped with req-592, req-1951 and req-2039 out of scope

Decision 2's open point: design may come back to this area once people have used it, and if so it returns as a new question — a gap claim naming the open point, never a decision, and matching the quote's 'if necessary we can return to the area and think of a way to do it'

Decision 3, import reference numbers: no Copy buttons; the reference and the customs code stay as text the trader can select, as the overview-and-review header row already builds them; inc-198 dropped with req-1986 out of scope

The 'Not covered here' paragraph: inc-194 (address search's search-only layout and lookup results as you type) stays deferred as concept work under ruling:sam-2026-11-09 point 2, and inc-014 (commodity search as you type) still waits on its own ticket under ruling:sam-2026-11-10 point 2 — this ruling settles neither, so each is recorded as what it is rather than as a decision of this file

For each of the three numbered items, whether the block quote says it in so many words (verbatim) or only implies it (inferred, with the words that imply it) — the quote names the three calls at headline level only, so every detail about Remove reloading the page, where the search applies, what main already does and which increments and requirements are dropped is the main session's reading to be marked accordingly
